title: Subsurface Utility Mapping for Safe Urban Excavation in Cross-Border Regions

record.title: Subsurface Utility Mapping for Safe Urban Excavation in Cross-Border Regions
record.summary: SUBMAP addressed the lack of harmonised subsurface utility mapping practice across the Hungary–Serbia border region, where cross-border infrastructure projects regularly encounter undocumented buried assets. The project developed joint field survey protocols combining GPR and EMI detection, a shared GIS data model aligned with both Hungarian and Serbian national standards, and a training programme for municipal geodetic services. Jeremić led the work package responsible for Serbian pilot surveys covering 62 km of streets in Subotica and Kanjiža, producing quality-level-attributed cadastre outputs. The project trained 34 municipal surveyors and produced a bilingual Hungarian–Serbian field manual for subsurface utility detection, freely distributed to partner municipalities.
